pkgmetadata.longdescription: Node.js slotted by major version, so several majors can be installed side by side. Each slot lives in /usr/lib*/node-MAJOR and provides nodeMAJOR, npmMAJOR and npxMAJOR in /usr/bin; the unversioned node, npm and npx follow the slot chosen with app-eselect/eselect-nodejs. Prepending /usr/lib*/node-MAJOR/bin to PATH runs a whole project, including its npm scripts, with that major.
